fullDescription: A high-intensity, dark-mode monitoring interface designed for real-time alerts and disaster reporting. Features a vibrant red-to-orange gradient palette (#ff2d55 to #ff6a00), editorial-grade typography (Clash Grotesk), and data-rich card layouts. The aesthetic blends a futuristic cyberpunk vibe with professional utility, using subtle seismic grid backgrounds, ambient radial glows, and animated scanlines. Ideal for emergency response apps, cybersecurity dashboards, fintech monitoring, and live data tracking verticals.
prompt:
## Resumo
Gising! — Reports is a high-fidelity monitoring dashboard featuring a categorized list of severity-based alerts (Critical, High, Moderate) with a dark theme and aggressive red/orange accent system. It utilizes a grid-based background, staggered entrance animations, and data-dense cards with expandable details.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a dark background (#0a0608) and a subtle 28px square seismic grid overlay in rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Typography: Use 'Clash Grotesk' for titles (SemiBold/Bold) and 'Satoshi' for body. Primary Accents: Gradient from #ff2d55 to #ff6a00. Status Colors: Critical (#ff2d55), High (#ff6a00), Moderate (#f5c518). Components should have 16px corner radii. Inputs use #1a0d11 with 1.5px borders (#2e1520). Apply a scanline animation (fixed 2px height, linear-gradient 90deg from transparent to 8% red) moving vertically over 6 seconds. Navigation items use 10px uppercase labels with 0.1em tracking.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header & Live Indicator
Top-aligned header with a large Clash Grotesk title ('Reports.'). Adjacent to the title, include a 'Live Pill' (rgba(255,45,85,0.12) background, 1px border) containing a blinking 6px red dot and text 'MONITORING ACTIVE'. Background should have a top-down radial glow from #ff2d55 at 18% opacity.

### Search and Filter Layer
A search input with a left-aligned Lucide icon, background #1a0d11, border 1.5px #2e1520. Below, a horizontal scrollable row of 'Filter Chips'. Active chip: #ff2d55 gradient with white text and a 12px shadow. Inactive chip: #1a0d11 background, #6b3345 text, 1.5px border.

### Summary Statistics Row
A flex-row of 4 mini-cards. Each card: #130b0e background, 1px #2e1520 border, containing a 10px uppercase label and a large 22px Clash Grotesk number. Color code numbers: Red for Critical, Orange for High, Yellow for Moderate, White for Total.

### Alert Card List
List of cards with 16px radius. Each card features a 4px wide color-coded severity bar on the far left. Layout: Top row contains a type icon in a 36px rounded square (15% opacity background of the icon color), title, and subtitle; Right side shows a large 'Magnitude/Value' display in Clash Grotesk (28px) with a glowing text-shadow. Below the title row, include a flex-wrap row of small pill-badges for metadata (e.g., depth, time since event).

### Expandable Card Detail
Inner detail panel for cards: Background rgba(255,45,85,0.04), border 1px rgba(255,45,85,0.12). Content includes icon-prefixed text rows (Map Pin, Clock, Zap) and a SVG sparkline representing a seismic waveform in #ff2d55 at 1.5px stroke width.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Expand/Collapse Button — Minimalist toggle button for card details.
Padding 4px 10px, background rgba(255,45,85,0.08), border 1px rgba(255,45,85,0.2), radius 8px. Text: 11px Bold, color #ff9ab0. Includes a 12px chevron icon that flips on state change.

### Bottom Navigation Bar — Fixed navigation bar with highlighted active state.
Height: 84px including bottom safe area. Background #0e080b, top-border 1px #2e1520. Icons: Lucide set. Active state: Red text/icon (#ff2d55) with 10px uppercase labels. Inactive state: Muted burgundy (#6b3345).

### Magnitude Display — High-impact data readout with glow.
Clash Grotesk font, size 28px, weight 700. Color #ff2d55 for critical levels. Apply text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,45,85,0.6). Sub-label below in 9px uppercase, bold, tracking 0.06em, color #6b3345.

style.description: The style is 'Critical/Action-Oriented Dark Mode.' Typography pairings use 'Clash Grotesk' for bold, impactful headers and numerical data, while 'Satoshi' handles clean, legible body text. The color scheme is anchored by deep black (#0a0608), accented with a signature red (#ff2d55) and orange (#ff6a00) gradient. Interactions are defined by micro-pulses, scanlines, and high-contrast status badges.
